traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Marsileaceae and Marsilea: small plants of water and mud on creeping rhizomes; fronds unroll from croziers and stand in two rows along the upper side; veins forking in pairs; Marsilea's leaf is a stalk with four clover-like leaflets, floating in deep water and held above it in shallow; sporangia in hard sporocarps at the frond's base. Pilularia's leaves are threads without a blade, the rare state here.

traits.vernation.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 115, 116, family Marsileaceae: vernation circinate; read as "circinate".

traits.reproduction.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 115, 116, family Marsileaceae: reproduction spores (heterosporous); read as "spores".
